title: English Keybinds
description: Stops Minecraft from translating keybind labels and forces standard English characters in the Controls menu, ignoring your keyboard layout.
body:
# Notice

**I've started doing Minecraft commissions in my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/Ce6Vty6khA)!**

# English Keybinds

This mod prevents keybind labels from being translated based on your keyboard layout.

## Why?

Minecraft determines keybind labels based on your active keyboard layout when you first open the Controls menu.
If you enter in the Controls menu with a Russian layout, your standard `WASD` binds will be displayed as `ЦФЫВ`, which is very misleading.
This mod forces the game to always display keybinds as capital English characters.

## Important

This mod targets **QWERTY keyboards only**.
If you use other keyboard types, the mod behavior is undefined.
